about: Supreme Groomers is a mobile and house-call pet grooming service in Singapore — bathing, brushing, nail trimming and ear cleaning, strictly by appointment.

services.name: Full Grooming
services.description: Shower and fluff, scissors or shaving, ear and eye cleansing.

services.name: Bath & Tidy
services.description: Bathing, brushing and blow-dry for a fresh, clean coat.

services.name: Nail Trimming
